title: Special Session in CI in Aerospace Applications
summary: This MCII special session focuses on computational intelligence for aerospace systems, missions, vehicles, and autonomous space operations.

bullets.label: 2027 IEEE Symposium for Multidisciplinary Computational Intelligence Incubators (IEEE MCII)

sections.heading: Session Chairs
bullets: Weineng Chen, South China University of Technology
Chunxue Liu, Beijing Microelectronics Technology Institute
Feng-Feng Wei, South China University of Technology

sections.heading: Topics of Interest
paragraphs: Topics of interest include, but are not limited to:
bullets: Planning and scheduling for autonomous systems in space.
Advances in CI for aerospace applications.
Intelligent search and optimization methods in aerospace applications.
Optimal control of aircraft, UAVs, spacecraft or rovers.
Space situational awareness and collision avoidance.
